Kiruvchi buyurtmalarni aniqlash uchun zarur (faqat o\'qish, avtomatik bosishlarsiz)
Boshqa ilovalar ustida suzuvchi natija vidjetini ko\'rsatish uchun zarur

WayArs yetkazib berish/taksi ilovalarida ekranda ko\'rsatilgan buyurtma tafsilotlarini (narx, masofa, vaqt) o\'qiydi, bu tezroq qaror qabul qilishga yordam beradi. U hech qachon avtomatik ravishda biror narsani bosmaydi yoki o\'zgartirmaydi.

WayArs Android AccessibilityService API’dan foydalanadi. U ilovaning asosiy funksiyasi uchun kerak: siz foydalanadigan yetkazib berish va taksi ilovalari ekranidagi buyurtma takliflarini avtomatik o‘qish, shunda WayArs sof foydangizni hisoblab, skanerlash yoqilgan paytda suzuvchi oynada baho (yaxshi / maqbul / yomon) ko‘rsatadi.

Qanday ishlatiladi:
• U qo‘llab-quvvatlanadigan ilovalar (va siz o‘zingiz qo‘shgan ilovalar) buyurtma taklifi paydo bo‘lganda ko‘rsatadigan matnni o‘qiydi: narx, masofa va taxminiy vaqt.
• Parollar, xabarlar va siz yozgan narsa hech qachon o‘qilmaydi. Boshqa ilovalar ko‘rsatgan hamma narsa darhol e’tiborga olinmaydi.
• WayArs ekranda hech qachon hech narsani bosmaydi, yozmaydi, aylantirmaydi yoki o‘zgartirmaydi va qo‘ng‘iroqlarni yozib olish uchun ishlatilmaydi.

Ma’lumotlarga nima bo‘ladi:
• Ular faqat shu qurilmada foydani hisoblash uchun qayta ishlanadi. Hech narsa serverga yuborilmaydi, ulashilmaydi, sotilmaydi va reklama uchun ishlatilmaydi.
• Qabul qilingan buyurtmalar bo‘yicha qurilmada faqat yig‘ma raqamlar (narx, masofa, vaqt, foyda) statistikangiz uchun saqlanadi.

Nazorat sizda: xizmat faqat Android sozlamalarida yoqganingizdan keyin ishlaydi va uni istalgan vaqtda o‘chirishingiz mumkin. Agar ixtiyoriy bildirishnomalar ruxsatini ham yoqsangiz, WayArs faqat qo‘llab-quvvatlanadigan ilovalarning yangi buyurtmalar haqidagi bildirishnomalarini o‘qiydi.

Ixtiyoriy zaxira kanal — ilova yig\'ilgan holatda bildirishnoma sifatida kelgan buyurtmalarni ushlaydi
Bu ilova uchun hali skanerlash ma\'lumotlari yo\'q. Uni faol buyurtma ekraniga oching va bir necha soniya kuting, so\'ng bu oynani qayta oching.
Quyida WayArs ushbu ilova ekranidan oxirgi marta o\'qigan matn keltirilgan. Avval narxi bo\'lgan qatorni, keyin masofani, so\'ng vaqtni bosing.
Savollar, g‘oyalar yoki buyurtmalar bilan muammo? Istalgan vaqtda yozing.
WayArs hozir bu ilovadan nimani o‘qiyapti
Bu ilova buyurtmalari avtomatik o‘qiladi. Kalibrlash shart emas.
WayArs bu yerda hammasini o‘qimayapti. Raqamlar qayerdaligini ko‘rsating — pastda 3 ta qisqa qadam.
WayArs bu buyurtmani siz tanlagandan boshqacha o‘qiyapti. Qaytadan boshlash tugmasini bosib, boshqa raqamlarni tanlang yoki baribir saqlang.
Oxirgi skanerda raqamlar yo‘q. Bu ilovada haqiqiy buyurtmani oching, bir necha soniya kuting va bu yerga qayting.

"**WayArs**
Yetkazib berish va taksi uchun shaxsiy yordamchingiz

Versiya: %1$s

WayArs — taksi va yetkazib berish ilovalarida ishlaydigan haydovchilar va kuryerlar uchun yaratilgan obuna asosidagi vosita.

Ilova ekrandagi ma'lumotlar va bildirishnomalarni avtomatik tahlil qiladi, bu esa buyurtmani olish arziydimi yoki yo'qmi tezda baholashga va daromadingizni real vaqt rejimida kuzatishga yordam beradi.

**Ilova nima qiladi**
• Yetkazib berish yoki taksi ilovasi ustida buyurtma bahosi: foydali, o‘rtacha yoki foydasiz — va yoqilg‘i, soliq va hamkor komissiyasidan keyin qo‘lingizda haqiqatda qancha qoladi.
• Statistika: kutishni hisobga olgan haqiqiy soatlik daromad, qaysi ilova qachon ko‘proq to‘laydi, yutuqlar va seriyalar.
• Kun va hafta yakunlari, Active tugmali bosh ekran vidjeti va Wear OS soatida baho tebranishi.
• Wayo — yordamchi xameleon: ilova haqidagi savollarga javob beradi va telefon sozlamalarini tekshiradi.
• Istalgan mamlakat va valyuta, kilometr yoki mil, 17 til.

**Dizayn va ishlab chiqish:** AP STUDIO
**Aloqa va yordam:** apstudiomobile@gmail.com
**Telegram:** t.me/wayars_app

Barcha uchinchi tomon savdo belgilari, logotiplari va ilova nomlari (jumladan, lekin ular bilan cheklanmagan holda Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart va foydalanuvchi tomonidan qo'shilgan boshqalar) o'z egalariga tegishli va faqat ma'lumot va identifikatsiya maqsadlarida ishlatiladi."

"**WayArs Privacy Policy**
Last updated: November 14, 2026

**Protecting your privacy**
We respect your privacy. WayArs is developed and operated by Arsenii Panicev (AP STUDIO), an independent developer. WayArs is designed around Privacy by Design — the core screen-analysis and rate-calculation operations run locally on your device.

**Data collection and use**
• Accessibility Service: the app uses this access exclusively to read order details (e.g. price, distance) shown on screen by the supported delivery and taxi apps (built in and added by you) in order to calculate order profitability. The app does not record passwords, personal data or keystrokes. Data read through the service is processed locally on your device, is not sent to external servers, and is not shared with third parties or used for advertising. The service never taps, types or changes anything on the screen and is not used to record calls. Events from all other apps are ignored immediately: nothing from them is read or stored. Before the service can be enabled, the app shows a disclosure and asks for your consent, and you can turn it off at any time.
• Notifications (Notification Listener): notification access is optional and is used only to detect new order offers from the supported apps while the app runs in the background. Other notifications are not read or stored.
• Order history: for the statistics screen the app saves, on your device only, for each order you accepted: the amount, currency, distance, time, calculated rates, estimated fuel cost, net profit, the take-home amount (after partner commission, fuel and tax), the verdict and which supported app the order came from (e.g. Bolt or Uber). It contains no addresses, names or other personal details and is never sent anywhere.
• Settings you enter: fuel consumption, fuel price, evaluation thresholds, tax rate, partner (fleet) commission and weekly payment, currency, language and your on/off choices are stored only in local device storage.
• Free trial: to provide the one-time free trial of scanning, the app stores on your device a counter of how long scanning has run. It is not sent anywhere.
• Installed apps list: when you add an app to scan, the app shows the launchable apps installed on your device. The list is not stored or sent anywhere; only the apps you choose are saved locally.
• Floating overlay: the “display over other apps” permission is used only to show the order verdict card above the delivery or taxi app. No data is collected through it.
• App updates: the app asks Google Play whether a newer version is available (Google Play in-app updates API).
• Working time: to calculate real earnings per hour, the app stores on your device when the “Active” switch was turned on and off (kept for up to about 400 days). It is not sent anywhere.
• Wayo the helper: the helper’s level and energy are calculated from your decisions on the order card and stored only on your device. Questions you type into the helper are searched locally and are not saved or sent anywhere.
• Notifications and watch: day and week summaries are composed on your device from the local order history. If you turn on “Verdict on the watch”, each new order is posted as a short notification (verdict, amount, distance, app name); Android and your watch’s companion app (e.g. Wear OS, Galaxy Wearable) mirror it to your paired watch under their own settings and policies. WayArs does not send this data to us or to anyone else.
• Home-screen widget: shows today’s take-home, number of orders and per-hour rate from local data; anyone who can see your home screen can see it. You can remove the widget at any time.
• Invite code: the app creates a random code on your device for invitations. When you tap “Invite”, the message with the Google Play link and the code is sent only through the app you choose (e.g. a messenger). Google Play may count installs from such links in anonymous, aggregated statistics.

**Subscriptions and third-party providers**
The app offers features on a subscription basis. The app does not collect or store detailed payment data (such as credit card numbers). To process transactions and verify subscription status, we rely on trusted third-party providers:
• Google Play Billing (Google LLC): payments and transactions are handled directly by the Google Play Store. Policy: policies.google.com/privacy
• RevenueCat, Inc.: subscription status verification based on anonymous device and transaction identifiers. RevenueCat may also process technical connection data such as an IP address. Policy: revenuecat.com/privacy

**Invitations and contacting us**
If you take part in the “Invite a driver” program or contact us (by e-mail, Telegram or social networks), we process the data you send us: your account name in that service, your messages, the invite code, a screenshot of the Google Play receipt and the order number.
• Purpose: to answer you, to check that the invited driver has bought a paid subscription (we look up the order number in Google Play Console) and to grant the reward.
• Legal basis: your request and your participation in the program (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in preventing abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
• Retention: invitation data is deleted no later than 90 days after the reward is granted or refused; other messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request.
• You can ask us at any time what data we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority (in Poland: the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, UODO).

**Children’s privacy**
WayArs is intended solely for adults who are legally permitted to work as a driver or courier. The app is not directed at children under 16 and does not knowingly collect or process any personal data from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with any data, please contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com so we can take appropriate action promptly.

**Managing permissions and your subscription**
You can revoke granted permissions at any time in Android system settings, or manage and cancel your subscription directly in your Google Play account settings.

**Data deletion and retention**
WayArs has no user accounts, and we do not operate our own servers that store your personal data. Data entered in the app is stored locally on your device and can be deleted at any time by clearing the app data (Android Settings → Apps → WayArs → Storage → Clear data) or by uninstalling the app. The app does not use Android automatic cloud backup, so your local data is not copied to your Google account. To request deletion of technical subscription identifiers processed by RevenueCat, contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com.

**Contact**
Developer: AP STUDIO (Arsenii Panicev)
apstudiomobile@gmail.com
Telegram: t.me/wayars_app"

"**WayArs foydalanish shartlari**
Oxirgi yangilanish: 2026-yil 14-noyabr

**Umumiy qoidalar**
WayArs ilovasidan foydalanish orqali siz quyidagi shartlarni qabul qilasiz. Ilova AP STUDIO tomonidan yaratilgan mustaqil yordamchi vosita bo'lib, u hech qanday uchinchi tomon ilova provayderlari (Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart yoki foydalanuvchi qo'shgan boshqalar kabi) bilan rasmiy aloqada emas, ular tomonidan homiylik qilinmagan yoki tasdiqlanmagan.

**Yordamchi xarakter va uchinchi tomon ilovalari**
• Ilova faqat ma'lumot va tahlil maqsadlarida mo'ljallangan. Foydalilik ko'rsatkichlari (valyuta/km, taxminiy foyda) foydalanuvchi kiritgan ma'lumotlar va ekrandan olingan o'qishlar asosida hisoblanadi.
• Foydalanuvchilar qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan uchinchi tomon ilovalarini o'zlari qo'shishlari mumkin. AP STUDIO foydalanuvchi qo'lda qo'shgan ilovalar uchun ma'lumotlarning to'g'ri o'qilishiga kafolat bermaydi.
• Statistika, haqiqiy soatlik daromad, ilovalarni solishtirish, yutuqlar, yakunlar, vidjet va soatdagi baholar ilova ekrandan o‘qigan ma’lumotlar va siz kiritgan qiymatlarga (yoqilg‘i, soliq, hamkor komissiyasi) asoslangan taxminlardir; ular platformalarning rasmiy hisobotlari ham, soliq hujjatlari ham emas.

**Foydalanuvchi yoshi**
Ilovadan kamida 16 yoshga to‘lgan va o‘z mamlakati qonunlariga ko‘ra kuryer yoki haydovchi bo‘lib ishlashi mumkin bo‘lgan shaxslar foydalanishi mumkin (taksi va yo‘lovchi tashish uchun odatda 18+ talab qilinadi). Ilova 16 yoshdan kichik bolalar uchun mo‘ljallanmagan.

**Obunalar va to'lovlar**
• Obuna to'lovlari tanlangan rejaga muvofiq Google Play Store tomonidan yig'iladi.
• Foydalanuvchilar istalgan vaqtda Google Play hisob sozlamalarida obunani yangilanishini bekor qilishlari mumkin.
• Pul qaytarish Google Play Store qoidalari va siyosatiga muvofiq amalga oshiriladi.

**“Haydovchini taklif qilish” dasturi**
• Pullik WayArs obunasini sotib olgan har bir taklif qilingan haydovchi uchun (sinov muddati hisobga olinmaydi) bir oy bepul olishingiz mumkin.
• Buning uchun ikkalangiz ham bizga Telegram’da t.me/wayars_app yozing: siz — taklif kodingizni; taklif qilingan haydovchi — o‘sha kodni va buyurtma raqami ko‘rsatilgan Google Play cheki skrinshotini.
• Mukofot buyurtma tekshirilgandan so‘ng Google Play promo-kodi yoki bir oylik to‘lovni qaytarish shaklida beriladi. Uni pulga almashtirib bo‘lmaydi.
• Har bir taklif qilingan haydovchi uchun bitta mukofot. O‘zini taklif qilish, bir nechta hisobdan foydalanish yoki keyinchalik puli qaytarilgan xarid hisobga olinmaydi.
• Suiiste’mol holatida mukofotni rad etishimiz, dasturni istalgan vaqtda o‘zgartirishimiz yoki to‘xtatishimiz mumkin; tasdiqlangan mukofotlar kuchda qoladi.

**Javobgarlikdan voz kechish**
• AP STUDIO ekranni noto'g'ri o'qish yoki uchinchi tomon ilovalari interfeysidagi yangilanishlar/o'zgarishlar natijasida yuzaga kelgan hisob-kitoblardagi nomuvofiqliklar uchun javobgar emas.
• AP STUDIO foydalanuvchi ilova ko'rsatkichlari asosida qabul qilgan moliyaviy, tijorat yoki haydash qarorlari uchun javobgar emas.
• Foydalanuvchilar telefondan xavfsiz foydalanishlari va haydash paytida yo'l harakati qoidalariga qat'iy rioya qilishlari shart.
• AP STUDIO foydalanuvchining uchinchi tomon xizmatlaridagi (Uber, Bolt, Wolt va h.k.) hisoblarining vaqtinchalik yoki doimiy bloklanishi uchun javobgar emas.
• Foydalanuvchi ilovadan to'liq o'z xavf-xatari ostida foydalanadi va undan foydalanish yoki foydalanmaslikni mustaqil hal qiladi.
• Ilova mustaqil yordamchi vosita bo'lib, biror taksi yoki yetkazib berish platformasi bilan rasmiy aloqasi yo'q.
• Haydash paytida telefon yoki soatga qaramang; soatning tebranishi aynan nigohingizni yo‘ldan uzmasligingiz uchun.

**Aloqa**
Savollar, izohlar yoki xatoliklar haqida xabarlarni quyidagi manzilga yuboring: apstudiomobile@gmail.com."

Sinov yoki obuna tugagan, yoki maxsus imkoniyatlar xizmati o‘chirilgan. Agar Android WayArs’ni fonda yopgan bo‘lsa, “Active” o‘zi qayta yoqiladi.
Ha, WayArs fonda ishlaydi. Buyurtmaning o‘zi ekranda bo‘lishi kerak: WayArs yetkazib berish yoki taksi ilovasi ko‘rsatgan narsani o‘qiydi.
Bir vaqtda bir nechta ilovadan foydalansam bo‘ladimi?
Ha. WayArs barcha qo‘llab-quvvatlanadigan ilovalarni bir vaqtda kuzatadi va buyurtma qaysi ilovadan kelganini ko‘rsatadi.
Juda kam: u faqat ilova ekranini o‘zgartirganda matnni o‘qiydi. Android to‘xtatmasligi uchun batareyani “Cheklovsiz” rejimiga qo‘ying.
Faqat kartada ✓ bilan belgilangan buyurtmalar saqlanadi. O‘tkazib yuborilganlar hisoblanmaydi.
Majburiy emas: ilova yig‘ib qo‘yilganda bildirishnoma bo‘lib keladigan buyurtmalarni ushlash uchun zaxira yo‘l. Sozlamalar → Ruxsatlar bo‘limida yoqing.
Ha: WayArs buyurtmalarni istalgan til va valyutada, km, mil yoki metrda o‘qiydi. Faqat sozlamalarda valyutangizni tanlang.
Sozlamalar → Qo\'llab-quvvatlanadigan ilovalar → ilova yonidagi qalamcha → “Kalibrlashni tozalash”.
Boshqa ilovalar ustidan ko‘rsatishga ruxsat bor
Hammasi sozlangan! Buyurtmalar baribir ko‘rinmasa, yetkazib berish yoki taksi ilovasini oching, buyurtma kuting va kalibrlashni tekshiring.
❌ belgili bandlarni tuzating — buyurtmalar paydo bo‘ladi.

Agar hamkor (park) orqali ishlasangiz, uning komissiyasini (har buyurtmadan %) va haftalik to‘lovni kiriting. Buyurtma kartasi qo‘lingizda haqiqatda qancha qolishini ko‘rsatadi, statistika esa haftalik to‘lovni ayiradi.
Kechqurun — bugun qancha topganingiz, dushanba ertalab — butun hafta. Faqat buyurtmali kunlar uchun.
Wear OS soati (Galaxy Watch, Pixel Watch) har buyurtmada tebranadi: 1 qisqa — foydali, 2 qisqa — yo‘q, 1 uzun — o‘rtacha. Soatda WayArs bildirishnomalariga ruxsat berilishi kerak.
Bugungi daromad va “Active” tugmasi ilovani ochmasdan. Yoki o‘zingiz qo‘shing: bosh ekrandagi bo‘sh joyni bosib turing → Vidjetlar → WayArs.
Haydovchini taklif qiling — bir oy bepul oling. Do‘stingiz obuna bo‘lganda, ikkalangiz ham bizga Telegram’da @wayars_app yozing: do‘stingiz kodingizni va Google Play cheki skrinshotini yuboradi.

Men WayArs’dan foydalanaman — Bolt, Uber yoki Wolt buyurtmasi qabul qilishdan oldin foydalimi-yo‘qmi ko‘rsatadi. Sinab ko‘r: %1$s\nTaklif kodim: %2$s. Obuna bo‘lgach, uni Google Play cheki skrinshoti bilan t.me/wayars_app ga yubor.
“Active” yoqilgan butun vaqtni, buyurtmalar orasidagi kutish bilan birga hisoblaydi.
“Active” yoqilgan holda bir necha smena ishlang va qabul qilgan buyurtmalarni kartada ✓ bilan belgilang — shunda ilovalarni haqiqiy soat bo‘yicha solishtiraman.

Statistika → yuqoridagi “Haqiqiy soatbay, qo‘lga” kartasi: qo‘lingizda qolgan summa “Active” yoqilgan butun vaqtga, buyurtmalar orasidagi kutish bilan birga bo‘linadi. Bugun, Hafta, Oy yoki Yilni tanlang.
Qayerda ko‘proq topaman — Boltdami yoki Uberdami?

Statistika → “Qayerda foydaliroq (60 kun)”: har bir ilovaning 60 kunlik haqiqiy soatlik daromadi, hafta kunlari va kun vaqti bo‘yicha ham, masalan “payshanba, kechqurun: Bolt 34/soat · Uber 26/soat”. Qabul qilgan buyurtmalarni kartada ✓ bilan belgilang, shunda ularni hisoblayman; har bir ilovada kamida 2 buyurtma kerak.
Hamkor (park) orqali ishlayman. Uning komissiyasini qanday hisobga olaman?
Sozlamalar → “Hamkor (park)”: komissiyani % da va haftalik to‘lovni kiriting. Buyurtma kartasi “hamkor −…” va qo‘lingizda qoladigan summani ko‘rsatadi; statistika haftalik to‘lovni ayiradi.
Statistika bo‘limida: “Haqiqiy soatbay, qo‘lga” kartasi tanlangan davr uchun haftalik to‘lov ulushini ayiradi (hafta — to‘liq, kun — 1/7). Buyurtma kartasi faqat % komissiyani ayiradi.
Kun va hafta yakunini qanday olaman?

Sozlamalar → “Qo‘shimcha” → “Kun va hafta yakuni”. Soat 21:00 da (“Active” hali yoqilgan bo‘lsa — o‘chirgandan keyin, kechi bilan 23:30 da) kun yakuni, dushanba soat 9:00 da hafta yakuni keladi. Bildirishnomalarga ruxsat bo‘lishi kerak.
Sozlamalar → “Qo‘shimcha” → “Vidjet qo‘shish” yoki bosh ekrandagi bo‘sh joyni bosib turing → Vidjetlar → WayArs. U bugungi daromadni ko‘rsatadi va “Active”ni yoqib-o‘chiradi.

Statistika → “Yutuqlar”: foydasiz buyurtma qabul qilmasdan ketma-ket kunlar (dam olish kunlari seriyani buzmaydi), soatlik rekord, eng yaxshi kun va buyurtma, 3, 7 va 30 aqlli kun, 100 va 1000 buyurtma, 100 soat uchun nishonlar.
Hamkasbimni qanday taklif qilib, bir oy bepul olaman?

Sozlamalar → “Qo‘shimcha” → “Taklif qilish”: havolani hamkasbingizga yuboring — kodingiz xabarda allaqachon bor. Do‘stingiz obuna bo‘lganda, ikkalangiz ham bizga Telegram’da t.me/wayars_app yozing: siz — uni taklif qilganingizni, do‘stingiz — kodingizni va buyurtma raqami (GPA.…) bo‘lgan Google Play cheki skrinshotini. Tekshiruvdan so‘ng bir oy bepul olasiz.

Sozlamalar → “Qo‘shimcha” → “Soatda baho”. Wear OS soati tebranadi: 1 qisqa — foydali, 2 qisqa — yo‘q, 1 uzun — o‘rtacha. Galaxy Wearable yoki Pixel Watch ilovasida WayArs bildirishnomalariga ruxsat bering; Galaxy Watch’da telefondan foydalanayotganda ham bildirishnomalarni yoqing, aks holda telefon ekrani yoniq bo‘lsa soat jim turadi.
Albatta! Barmog‘ingizni ustimdan yurgizing — ko‘zlarimni yumaman, tebranaman va yurakchalar uchadi 💚. Silash energiya bermaydi: men faqat aqlli qarorlaringizdan o‘saman. Qisqa bosish yordamni ochadi.

Yordamchi xameleoningiz. Unga bosing — ilova haqidagi istalgan savolga javob beradi va telefonni tekshiradi; barmog‘ingizni ustidan yurgizing — uni silaysiz. U aqlli qarorlardan o‘sadi: foydali buyurtmalarni olish va foydasizlarini o‘tkazib yuborish.

Agar hamkor (park) orqali ishlasangiz, uning komissiyasini % da va haftalik to‘lovni kiriting. Buyurtma kartalari qo‘lingizda haqiqatda qancha qolishini ko‘rsatadi. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ishlasangiz, bo‘sh qoldiring.
Bildirishnomalarda kun va hafta yakuni, Wear OS soatida tebranishli baho, Active tugmali bosh ekran vidjeti va bir oy bepul uchun haydovchini taklif qilish.
Qisqacha yangiliklar: yordamchi Wayo, haqiqiy soatlik daromad va ilovalarni solishtirish, hamkor komissiyasi, kun yakuni, vidjet, soat va takliflar.
